name: orderak-os
description: Orderak OS - نظام كاشير وإدارة مطاعم (Offline-first POS for Sudan)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
